Over the past few days, our little learners explored the richness of Indian culture through music, dance, art, storytelling, books, and traditions. Each experience sparked curiosity, creativity, and joyful learning - helping children connect with culture in meaningful and engaging ways.

It looks like bright smiles, busy hands, and little eyes wide with wonder. We create a space where children can explore textures, discover stories, and make friends at their own gentle pace. Seeing them thrive, create, and grow with so much confidence reminds us why we love what we do every day.

featured_reviews.review_text: We are very happy with the way Little Palms team has handled teaching in this pandemic situation. They have provided us with the material to complete the weekly activities. The planners are also very well thought and executed. The sessions with the class teacher are also very nice. The kids are enjoying it as the teachers are able to address them personally and it’s very interactive. The dance and music sessions have always been a fun one for the kids. featured_reviews.name: Mahafrin Rustomjee
featured_reviews.review_text:
Little Palms has been incredibly patient with our child, allowing him to integrate slowly yet beautifully into a classroom setting. The joy with which they teach is evident, and the longevity of the staff shows their immense loyalty and faith in the curriculum. Their small batch groups and dedicated teachers, along with the support staff, ensure that every child receives individual attention and care.

The preschool's facilities are clean, safe, and well-equipped, providing a stimulating environment for young minds to explore and learn. They focus not just on the ABCs but also on the social and emotional development of each child, fostering essential skills such as teamwork, empathy, and problem-solving.

We appreciate the open communication between the teachers and parents, as well as the regular updates on our child's progress. Little Palms offers a balanced approach to early education, combining structured learning with ample playtime, which is crucial for overall development. We are so pleased to be part of the Little Palms community and are grateful for such a nurturing and supportive environment for our child to thrive in.

featured_reviews.name: Divya Soni
featured_reviews.review_text:
As mother of two young kids, who have both been blessed to be part of the Little Palms family, I can only say that the school is truly outstanding .

The school believes in all round development of the kid, and gently paces out the curriculum according to every kid's capability and developmental milestones.. The attention to each kid by the teachers and by the Principals Zarna and Rupal Aunty is amazing.. The emotional and social development is placed as highly as the intellectual development of the kid.. The school ethos is that it takes a happy child to learn, and the activities are blended to make it a fun learning experience for the kid.

What also amazed me , as a second time parent with my young two year old son, is how swiftly the school adapted its teaching methods during the unfortunate lockdown during the present pandemic.. The school sent detailed planners with stationary  kits, coupled with audio and video lessons to make virtual school a possibility.. even activities like dance, yoga and music were not lost during the virtual classes. Celebrations of all major festivals continued online, and the teachers and principals were available at call to address any feedback.

Very happy to be a part of the LP family, and highly recommend it to any new parent.

featured_reviews.name: Nishita Pitale
featured_reviews.review_text: My child has been at Little Palms from the age of 11 months and has grown into a confident young toddler under the guidance of Zarna Aunty and Rupal Aunty. When the country when into lockdown due to the Co-Vid 19 pandemic, Little Palms was a forerunner in providing us with immediate guidance on Homeschooling our children. From weekly planners to online Zoom sessions and even arts and craft Kits, the school has provided us with all mediums to provide quality education. Despite not attending school the children feel more connected than ever to their teachers and schools. I would recommend this playschool to those who believe in organic learning for their children.

featured_reviews.name: Riddhi Dharia
featured_reviews.review_text: The Mother Toddler program is fantastic at Little Palms. Sincerely appreciate all the efforts put in by the teachers and staff of Little Palms. Innovative (but easy to connect) ways of teaching different concepts to toddlers. I too had a great time attending this program with my little one. The student to teacher ratio is also very well balanced. Lovely way of celebrating various festivities at school by involving grand parents and giving a personal touch by customizing the gift backs. All in all do recommend the Mother Toddler program at Little Palms.

featured_reviews.name: Shraddha Ghadiali
featured_reviews.review_text: My daughter was happy from the very first day and enjoyed going to school! The teachers are great and have been there for several years. The school prepares your child well for big school such that you do not need outside classes. There is also a lot of emphasis on learning through field trips related to topics covered in school. The teachers are approachable and get to know your child very well. There isn’t too much mandatory parent involvement which is great for working parents. The events organised by the school are amazing and give your child exposure to being on stage and performing in front of large groups. Overall a fantastic school and a great foundation for the child. Highly recommend Little Palms!

featured_reviews.name: Bhairavi Sohni
featured_reviews.review_text: Our daughter has been attending Little Palms since Preschool. She was welcomed into the school as though it were home, right from day one. During the pandemic, every single teacher stepped up and embraced online schooling to equip our children with the skill set and values they would need to deal with this difficult time. The curriculum is carefully crafted, keeping in mind the child's social, emotional well being along with emphasis on motor and communication development. As a professional Speech and Language Pathologist catering to the population of toddlers and young children, I was mighty impressed with Zarna Aunty and Rupal aunty's methodologies and belief systems in nurturing these young minds. Their evidence based approach, while integrating play methods and inculcating important life skills helps mould our kids into independent little minds as they step out to take on high school. I highly recommend Little Palms to any parent out there looking for a solid foundation for their little toddlers.

name: Sophia Nursery School
description:
Sophia Nursery School, is a school with a difference where "Learning is fun" for “the Little Ones”.
It is located within the Sophia College Campus, which is one of the premier traditional and educational institutes of Mumbai. Established in 1971, the Sophia Nursery school has a wonderful history of more than fifty glorious years. It lays the foundation of learning in the formative years of the young ones. Keeping our motto “Learning is Fun” in mind, Sophia Nursery amalgamates all the assets of the Child’s development in a manner which enables each little one to shine like a sparkling, priceless Diamond.
Sophia Nursery promises all this and lots more.

featured_reviews.name: Shweta Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Having Sophia Nursery as a stepping stone and threshold to my son's foundational journey has been incredible. From the impeccable set up of each classroom to the spatial advantage of an in-house basketball court, well equipped garden and an all inclusive auditorium, nothing could get better.

The warmth and personalized attention of each teacher has been another booster.
The meticulously planned activities of each day and the outdoor trips, be it a simple recce to Crosswords, a trip to the salon or an educational tour to the Cooperage Traffic Park, have all given children a good amount of intellectual and outdoor exposure.

The festive celebrations, the annual Christmas concert, Sports Day and Project Day, deserve much applaud too

Shweta Shah(Ishaan), Proud Parent

featured_reviews.name: priyanka choudhary
featured_reviews.review_text:
We are very happy with Sopia Nursery School. My daughter truly enjoys going to school every day. The teachers are very caring, patient, and supportive with the children. I love seeing how excited she gets about all the fun activities, story time, and special events.
It’s wonderful to see her becoming more confident, social, and happy. Thank you to all the teachers and staff for creating such a warm, safe, and nurturing environment for our little ones. We really appreciate all the love and effort you put into the children. Highly recommended! 🌈

featured_reviews.name: THE MEHTABOLICS
featured_reviews.review_text:
We are from a large family. I can confidently say Sophia was the best start to our youngest member's education.

1. A wonderfully run school with the best of teachers, staff and facilities. The Sophia team is not just well qualified, they are extremely loving and patient - with both, parents and their kids.
2. A huge auditorium, a playground, a play area and a garden - one of the most spacious schools in South Mumbai
3. Premium student to teacher ratio
4. Individual and collective development of children
5. A diverse student pool making it a culturally rich environment for the child
6. Events such as Sports DAY, Annual Day etc are brilliantly thought of and executed - some of the best we have seen. Multiple smaller activities keep the child engaged and inspired
7. Forget the converted garages masquerading as schools, this is a rich, colouful, complete and true 'school' experience that we always wanted for our daughter.

Its been a great journey with Sophia. Will always be grateful to Sister Charlotte, Nisha teacher, Reena Teacher, Swati teacher, Rupali teacher, Sulochana ma'am and everyone else. Apologies if I have missed any name

featured_reviews.review_text: It's mean a magical and exciting journey for our daughter. She earned two years of love, knowledge, confidence. Thanx to the outstanding principal vice principal and teachers. The helpers poty train your children so carefully. All the events,field trips and way of teaching is so kids friendly that students repeat with smiles at home. May God bless each one at Sophia Nursery School to keep up the good work always.
